subject: mathematics
title: Simple interest
summary: Work out the interest on money saved or borrowed, and the total amount.

lesson.text: When you save money in a bank or borrow it, extra money called interest is added. With simple interest, it is worked out on the original amount only.

items: Principal (P): the money saved or borrowed.
Rate (R): the percentage charged each year, "per annum".

lesson.text: I = (P × R × T) ÷ 100, and A = P + I.

lesson.title: ₦20,000 saved at 5% per annum for 3 years

lesson.text: Rearrange the formula to find a missing value: R = (100 × I) ÷ (P × T), and T = (100 × I) ÷ (P × R).

lesson.title: ₦8,000 earns ₦1,200 in 3 years. What is the rate?

lesson.text: If time is in months, change it to years first: 6 months = 6/12 = 1/2 year.

questions.prompt: Find the simple interest on ₦50,000 at 10% per annum for 2 years.
₦12,000 is borrowed at 5% per annum for 4 years. What is the total amount to pay back?
How long will ₦10,000 take to earn ₦2,000 interest at 4% per annum?
Find the simple interest on ₦6,000 at 8% per annum for 6 months.
